//: mirbadllm-agent on the DGX Spark (P1, topology a; MN-041). Baked into the agent image as /etc/mirbadllm-agent/agent.json. Paths are as the agent CONTAINER sees them, except *HostPath (bind sources Docker uses for model and download containers). deploy/compose.multinode.yaml overrides the host-specific values with MIRBADLLM_AGENT_Agent__* variables (ModelsHostPath, CacheHostPath, MemoryReserveGiB, DownloadHelperImage). Keeps today's controller settings 1:1 (plan §3.6 W4 notes). MemoryModel Unified (P2, D102): the GB10's admission, /status and capability flags stay P1 whatever nvidia-smi reports.
